ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms browser targets, interaction steps and the fixed-sleep flag are declared; it does not drive a browser.
offer: Drive real interactions and wait for observable state transitions. Fixed sleeps hide synchronization defects and produce unreliable results under slower environments.

minimal.reason: List the browser targets the flows run against. Unnamed targets leave compatibility untested, so name each browser and version.

mid.reason: Write the interaction steps as observable actions. Vague steps cannot be replayed, so list each click, input and expected state.

maximal.reason: Set fixed sleeps to false. A sleep hides synchronization defects and flakes on slower machines, so wait on an observable state.
